items.title: Courtyard Homestay (demo)
items.description: Joglo-style homestay with a shared courtyard, 3 bedrooms, breakfast included. Walking distance to the city centre.

items.title: Rice Field Villa (demo)
items.description: Quiet villa on the northern edge of the city with a small pool, 4 bedrooms, kitchen.

items.title: Merapi Sunrise Jeep Tour (demo)
items.description: Early-morning jeep ride on the slopes of Mount Merapi with hotel pickup.

items.title: Batik Workshop (demo)
items.description: Two-hour hands-on batik class; you keep the piece you make.

items.title: Dago Hillside Guesthouse (demo)
items.description: Guesthouse in north Bandung with a city view, 3 bedrooms, breakfast included. Close to Dago's cafés.

items.title: Lembang Pine Villa (demo)
items.description: Villa among the pines in Lembang with a fire pit, 4 bedrooms, kitchen.

items.title: Tangkuban Perahu Sunrise Trip (demo)
items.description: Early pickup to the crater rim for sunrise, with a stop at a tea plantation.
